text:
Welcome to Quan Su Pagoda, or Chùa Quán Sứ, located at 73 Quan Su Street. This pagoda is deeply rooted in Buddhist history and plays an important role in the activities of the Vietnam Buddhist Sangha. It is not only a historical site but also an active religious place, so please remember that worship times do not align with visiting hours.

The pagoda is open daily from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM, and it extends its hours on full moon days, the first of the month, and during festivals, allowing visitors to experience the vibrant spiritual atmosphere during these times. As for the entrance fee, it is complimentary; there is no ticket charge to visit.

When you explore the pagoda, it is crucial to dress respectfully and conduct yourself in a manner that does not disturb the worshippers. Please be mindful of their practices and space during your visit. If you have any questions about visiting hours or specific guidelines, feel free to ask at the entrance. Enjoy your time at Quan Su Pagoda!
